Install GLiNER2 in the macrox Python environment

Source: R/gliner.R
setup_gliner.Rd

Installs the gliner2 Python package and pre-loads the requested model so it is ready for select_item() calls with backend = "gliner".

Usage

setup_gliner(
  model = "fastino/gliner2-base-v1",
  envname = "r-macrox",
  pip_options = character(0)
)

Arguments

model

Pre-trained model identifier (HuggingFace repo). Defaults to the 205M base model "fastino/gliner2-base-v1". The 340M large variant is "fastino/gliner2-large-v1".

envname

Python virtual environment name (default "r-macrox").

pip_options

Additional pip install options (character vector).

Value

NULL invisibly.
